versions.subject: fix: use doublequotes instead of ' because of ' in string
versions.detection:
cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'Set-ExecutionPolicy'
option:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Unrestricted'
        - 'bypass'
        - 'RemoteSigned'
filter:
    - ParentImage:
        - 'C:\ProgramData\chocolatey\choco.exe'
    - ScriptBlockText|contains: "(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1')"
condition: cmdlet and option and not filter
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Set-ExecutionPolicy*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*Unrestricted*", "*bypass*", "*RemoteSigned*") NOT (ParentImage="C:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\choco.exe" OR ScriptBlockText="*(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1')*")
